text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of doing everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. During each sprint, they focus on a set of tasks from a prioritized list known as the backlog. These tasks are often described as user stories, which explain a feature from the customer's perspective. Every day, the team holds a quick standup meeting to share progress and discuss any problems. This iterative development process means the team can regularly adapt and improve their work based on feedback, delivering value step by step rather than waiting until the very end.
